data.action: 坐在草地上，手捧家信与设计手记
data.description: 维多利亚郊外微风和煦的青青草地上，苏茜盘腿坐在花丛中，怀里抱着家人的来信与自己精心绘制的发型设计手记。她转过身拉住你的衣角，眼神里满是憧憬与感激——「能在这里重新拿起剪刀、和大家一起平静地生活……对我来说真的就像奇迹一样幸福。」
data.promptProse: With the family letter and hairstyle sketches held against her lap, she catches the viewer's hem with her free hand and turns toward them; bright meadow light warms her pink hair as the grass bends in the breeze.
data.title: 澄闪 · 原野手记
data.animaCaption: She holds the letter and sketches against her lap while her free hand catches the viewer's hem.
